description_zh: 带 min/max/step 的数值控件；光谱观感由参数名 / CSS tone 决定，不是单独控件类型
description_en: Numeric control with min/max/step; the spectrum look comes from the parameter name or CSS tone and is not a separate widget type
binds_zh: Int/Float 有界设定值（亮度、颜色 hue、色温、饱和度等）
binds_en: Int/Float bounded setpoint (brightness, hue, CCT, saturation, ...)

description_en: Pick from a fixed option set
binds_zh: Int/String；选项来自 parameters.csv 的 options JSON
binds_en: Int/String; options from the parameter's options JSON

description_zh: 字符串输入或只读展示
binds_zh: String（如 name）或计量读数（voltage_v / current_a / power_w / energy_wh）；access:R 时只读
binds_en: String (e.g. name) or metering readout (voltage_v / current_a / power_w / energy_wh); read-only when access: R

description_zh: 类型级「永不渲染」；参数仍可在目录中存在
description_en: Type-level never rendered; the parameter can still exist in the catalog
binds_zh: 任意类型；与实例 props.visible:false 不同（见 README）
binds_en: Any type; differs from instance props.visible:false (see README)

description_zh: 点击即下发命令的按钮控件；命令型参数(无值)，用于媒体控制等
description_en: Momentary command button (no value); used for media controls etc.
